title: Concept: Setuid bit set (shell) — review required
description: Setting setuid (chmods+(?:[0-7]*4[0-7]{3}|u+s)) promotes every caller to the file owner's privileges while the binary runs. Memory flaws, path handling, and environment inheritance all become escalation vectors. The remedy is capability-based design (capabilities or a privileged helper service).
applicability: shell provisioning scripts; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local privilege escalation through the binary; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for custom setuid code.
